title: Repeated store-loop depth exploration has no bounded Program action
observation: Authors repeatedly modify num_stages by hand on separate sum and apply/store regions. Retained kernel diagnostics are3.743us for the initial loop,3.735us when only reduction-region depth changes, and2.919us when the output-region depth changes. Existing range options already express this; no new pipeline primitive or general speedup follows.
proposed_change: Expose explicit named store-region depth selection through the existing Compiler/Program transformation catalog. Preserve the complete Schedule except result identity and the selected existing num_stages. Bound the qualified domain to fixed nonnested gfx938 pure store loops without carry, state, synchronization, residency or persistent mapping. Return a refusal instead of choosing or clamping a depth.
promotion_disposition: Promote the bounded reviewed capability after integration checks; preserve original failures and frozen runs. Performance, new shape coverage and equal-budget search benefit remain unproven.

verified_by.scope: Four emissions x five original cases pass20/20 on gfx938 with unchanged inputs; no timing or search-gain claim.
verified_by.software: Independent source review found no blocking issues after recorded corrections. Full contracts and offline compile results are owned by shared PR374/375 and this hardware integration PR.
